s: one, you, they (indefinite pronoun, referring to people at large; construed as a third-person singular)
Man kann nicht immer kriegen, was man will.

man.et: From Middle High German man, from Old High German man, from Proto-West Germanic *mann, from Proto-Germanic *mann- (“person”). Doublet of Mann. Cognate with English man, Dutch man, among many others (see the English entry for more).

s: Das sind man dreißig Stück oder so.
These are only thirty or so.
man.et: From Middle Low German man, a contracting alteration of Old Saxon newan (“none other than”). Compare the similar case of Dutch maar (“only”).

t: Es interessiert niemanden mehr, was man denkt.

Man hätte mir das nicht erlauben dürfen.
